I could not verify this against the literature or carry out a full classification, so the answer below is a recollection, not a derived result.

The problem concerns the classification of quadratic rational maps over $\mathbb{Q}$ with nonabelian automorphism groups, which I associate with work by John Doyle on preperiodic points. My recollection is that such maps have at most 9 $\mathbb{Q}$-rational preperiodic points, with 9 attained, but I cannot confirm the exact bound or its sharpness from memory.

ANSWER: 9
